Name: Rock Refinement
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Want more uses for gems and minerals? Tired of having nothing to do with minerals after donating them to the museum? Ever realize you only have bars when you need ores? Well, you've come to the right place! This mod adds 2 new artisan goods - Smooth Stone and Marbles, which can be made from minerals and gems respectively. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod adds the following items:[/size][/color]
[spoiler][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Sand.[/b] Obtained from crushing rocks in the rock crusher, and used as fuel for the rock tumbler.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Smooth Stone.[/b] Smooth and polished rocks obtained from placing minerals in the rock tumbler. This artisan good also benefits from the gemologist profession (Note - the bonus granted by this profession are only applied to smooth stones made after obtaining it)!
[i]Price Formula: 100 + 2B[/i][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Marbles.[/b] Obtained from placing gems in the rock tumbler.[/size][/color]
[i]Price Formula: 50 + 1.6B[/i]
*Note - B refers to the base price of the input item.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]and two new machines:[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]The Rock Crusher:[/b][/size][/color]
Obtained at Mining Level 3.
Creates:
[spoiler]The following input items result in the following outputs:
[list]
[*]Broken Glasses & Glass Shards: 2-3 sand[/*]
[*]Quartz & Fire Quartz: 1 sand[/*]
[*]Refined Quartz: 3 sand[/*]
[*]Earth Crystal: 1 of either stone, clay, or sand[/*]
[*]Sandstone: 10-20 sand[/*]
[*]Mudstone: 10-20 clay[/*]
[*]Limestone, Baryte & Granite: 10-20 stones[/*]
[*]Fairy Stone: 2-3 fairy dust[/*]
[*]All other minerals: 5-10 stones[/*]
[*]Stone: 1 sand[/*]
[*]Metal Bars: 4-5 of their respective ores[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]The Rock Tumbler:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Obtained at Mining Level 9.[/size][/color]
Creates Smooth Stone and Marbles.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow sand to be hoed from beaches.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Rock Refinement
Manifest.Description: Adds more uses for minerals and gems.
